Mark T. Vande Hei was selected by NASA in 2009.  Born in Virginia then raised in New Jersey and Minnesota, Vande Hei earned a Bachelor of Science in Physics from Saint John’s University and a Master of Science in Applied Physics from Stanford University.

  In 1999, he became an assistant professor of physics at the United States Military Academy in West Point.  After extending the record for the longest single spaceflight in history by an American to 355 days, NASA astronaut Mark Vande Hei returned to Earth in March 2022.
